claim_verdicts.evidence: gateway-down.sh posts POST /api/v1/orders/10/refund as anh.tran@example.com (seed.sql: customer 1; order (10, 1, ..., 'paid')); captured output: "-> 202". refund-design.md step 1: API moves the order to refunding, writes order.refund-requested to the outbox, returns 202; step 3: Payments writes a pending refund row; step 4: a background job calls the gateway.

RefundSender : BackgroundService; Tick = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2); BatchSize = 10; SendDueAsync calls BeginTransactionAsync, then ClaimDueAsync: "WHERE kind = 'refund' AND status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= {now} ... LIMIT {BatchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED". refund-design.md step 4: "cùng cách với NotificationSender: hai giây một lần ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED". Round 2: PaymentsDbContext.cs:7 and docker-compose.yml:367 confirm the database is donhang_payments.

PostgreSQL 17, SELECT, The Locking Clause: "With SKIP LOCKED, any selected rows that cannot be immediately locked are skipped." and "... can be used to avoid lock contention with multiple consumers accessing a queue-like table."

RefundAsync: IsSuccessStatusCode -> Refunded; StatusCode == UnprocessableEntity -> Refused with ReadReasonAsync; other status -> TryAgainLater "the gateway answered {code}"; catch HttpRequestException / TimeoutRejectedException / BrokenCircuitException -> TryAgainLater. Round 2: section 4 now says 'any other status, a broken connection or no answer in time', matching this list.
.NET docs, HttpClient: "You can use the HttpResponseMessage.IsSuccessStatusCode property to evaluate these codes as well, which ensures that the response status code is within the range 200-299".

Polly timeout strategy: "If the execution is canceled by the timeout strategy, it throws a TimeoutRejectedException." Polly circuit breaker: "Once the strategy opens the circuit, every subsequent call will be shortcut with a BrokenCircuitException." Program.cs adds AddCircuitBreaker (FailureRatio, MinimumThroughput, SamplingDuration, BreakDuration from GatewaySettings) then AddTimeout to this HttpClient.

GatewayRefundClient.cs:51 "public static string IdempotencyKeyFor(Payment refund) => $\"refund-{refund.Id}\";"; line 65 request.Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", IdempotencyKeyFor(refund)). RefundSenderTests.IdempotencyKeyFor_IsRefundAndTheRowId: Assert.Equal("refund-9", first) and the same key after refund.Attempts = 3.

fake-gateway/Program.cs: "A key seen before gets the answer it got then, and nothing is refunded again." lock(answers){ if (!answers.TryGetValue(key, out var answer)) { answer = Decide(key, body); answers[key] = answer; } return answer; }; Decide adds to refunds only on a new key; MapGet("/v1/refunds") returns refunds.ToArray().

Decide: Results.Ok(new { refundId = refund.RefundId, status = "refunded" }); refusals Results.UnprocessableEntity(new { reason = ... }). In DonHang.Payments the only Status assignments are "pending" (RefundRequestedConsumer.cs:107), "refunded" (RefundSender.cs:93), "failed" (RefundSender.cs:101).

RecordResult: refund.Attempts++; not Refunded, not Refused, before GiveUpAfter -> var delay = NextDelay(refund.Attempts); refund.NextAttemptAt = now + delay; LogWarning("... attempt {Attempt} failed ..."); return null. Test RecordResult_TryAgainLater_StaysPendingAndWaits asserts Null(message) and ("pending", 1).

RefundSettings: FirstRetryDelay = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1); MaxRetryDelay = TimeSpan.FromHours(1); GiveUpAfter = TimeSpan.FromHours(24). BackoffDelay: FirstRetryDelay * Math.Pow(2, attempts - 1), capped at MaxRetryDelay. Test BackoffDelay_DoublesUpToOneHour: InlineData (1,1), (2,2), (4,8), (7,60), (20,60).

NextDelay: backoff * (0.5 + Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 0.5) -> [backoff/2, backoff). BackoffDelay(1) = 1 min by default, so the first wait is at most 1 minute. Test NextDelay_IsBetweenHalfAndAllOfTheBackoff: Assert.InRange(delay, backoff / 2, backoff); RecordResult_TryAgainLater_StaysPendingAndWaits: InRange now+30s .. now+1min.

RefundSender.cs:91-96 Refunded -> Status = "refunded", return Message("payment.refunded", ...); :99 "if (result.Outcome == RefundOutcome.Refused || now - refund.RequestedAt >= settings.GiveUpAfter)" -> Status = "failed", Message("payment.refund-failed", ...). SendDueAsync adds the message to OutboxMessages, then SaveChangesAsync and CommitAsync of one transaction (:49-64). Tests RecordResult_Refunded_MarksRefundedAndAnnouncesIt, RecordResult_TryAgainLaterAfter24Hours_GivesUp.

issues.text: New in round 2 (changed text). The circuit does not open after 'many' failed calls: Program.cs takes FailureRatio, MinimumThroughput and SamplingDuration from GatewaySettings, defaults 0.5, 3 and 1 minute, so two failures out of three calls within a minute can open it. 'many' overstates the threshold.
